parts.text: 📢 Join the AIology Lab at Kennesaw State University - School of Data Science and Analytics <

> *and help shape the future of AI! 🤖✨

🎯 Target Start: Fall 2026 🗓️ Application Deadline: February 1, 2026

The AIology Lab at KSU is inviting applications for PhD students who are passionate about advancing the science and application of Artificial Intelligence and Analytics. Our mission is to design, evaluate, and apply AI-driven solutions that power data-informed decision-making across health, business, and social systems.

Research Areas Include:
- Human-AI Interaction
- Machine Behaviour
- Anthropomorphic AI
- Information Disorder
- Text mining and NLP
- Health and Medical Informatics

💰 Competitive Financial Support
• $3,000/month financial support
• Full tuition waiver
• Health insurance coverage

👩‍🎓 Ideal Candidates:
• Background in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Science,
Health/Medical Informatics, Information Systems, Statistics, HCI, Computational Social Science, or related fields
• Strong programming & ML skills
• Passion for AI/LLMs applied to health, business, and society

📬 Interested? Let’s Connect! 📧 Send your CV, best publication (optional), a copy of your BS+MS transcripts and a copy of your GRE and TOEFL/IELTS (for international students) to:
akarami@kennesaw.edu. ***Emails missing these attachments will not receive a response*.**
